title: Data Structures and Algorithms
content: Data structures organize and store data for efficient access and modification. Common data structures include arrays linked lists stacks queues trees and hash tables. Binary search trees provide O(log n) search insertion and deletion. Hash tables offer O(1) average case lookups using hash functions. Graph algorithms solve problems like shortest path and minimum spanning tree. Sorting algorithms like quicksort and mergesort have O(n log n) average time complexity. Choosing the right data structure is crucial for algorithm performance.
